{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Filter for loyal customers only
loyal_df = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate as the fraction of converted orders
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Print the exact value
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the value for submission
conversion_rate"}
